translations.web: beginning from the baptism of John, to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
translations.bsb: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
translations.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
